edges.reason: airdrop depends on msg.sender for the onlyOwner gate and the transferFrom allowance path.
_transfer uses block.timestamp to compute early sell tax windows.
_transfer keys the transfer-delay mapping on tx.origin.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the Uniswap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the Uniswap deadline.
newAmount is validated and written to swapTokensAtAmount.
account is written into the _isExcludedFromFees mapping.
recipients array drives the airdrop loop.
values array supplies transfer amounts in airdrop.
from is the sender used throughout _transfer.
to is the recipient used throughout _transfer.
amount is split into fees and transferred value in _transfer.
fees is computed from amount and fee percentages inside _transfer.
takeFee is derived from swapping and fee-exclusion state in _transfer.
isBuy is derived from automatedMarketMakerPairs in _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is read from balanceOf(address(this)) in _transfer.
amountToSwapForETH is derived from contractBalance minus liquidity tokens.
success captures the result of the low-level ETH calls.
enableTrading sets tradingActive to true.
enableTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
enableTrading records launchedAt = block.number.
removeLimits sets limitsInEffect to false.
disableTransferDelay sets transferDelayEnabled to false.
setEarlySellTax toggles enableEarlySellTax.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes swapTokensAtAmount.
updateMaxTxnAmount writes maxTransactionAmount.
updateMaxWalletAmount writes maxWallet.
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount.
updateSwapEnabled writes swapEnabled.
updateBuyFees writes buyTotalFees.
updateSellFees writes sellTotalFees.
excludeFromFees writes _isExcludedFromFees.
blacklistAccount writes _blacklist.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes automatedMarketMakerPairs.
updateMarketingWallet writes marketingWallet.
updateDevWallet writes devWallet.
_transfer reads _blacklist of from and to.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFees to decide fee taking.
_transfer reads and writes _holderFirstBuyTimestamp for early sell tax.
_transfer writes _holderLastTransferTimestamp keyed by tx.origin.
_transfer calls swapBack while state flags (swapping) are only partially protected.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth.
swapBack calls addLiquidity when liquidity tokens and ETH exist.
swapBack performs low-level ETH sends to dev and marketing wallets before finishing accounting.
airdrop loops over transferFrom calls.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external Uniswap router swap.
addLiquidity invokes the external Uniswap router addLiquidityETH.
The ETH send to the recipient wallet can re-enter _transfer/swapBack before state is settled.

normalization_plan.reason: newAmount is only meaningful as the argument merged into updateSwapTokensAtAmount.
account is only meaningful as the argument merged into excludeFromFees.
recipients is only meaningful as the airdrop input array.
values is only meaningful as the airdrop amount array.
from is only meaningful as an argument of _transfer.
to is only meaningful as an argument of _transfer.
amount is only meaningful as an argument of _transfer.
fees is a temporary value computed inside _transfer.
takeFee is a temporary flag computed inside _transfer.
isBuy is a temporary flag computed inside _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary snapshot read inside _transfer.
amountToSwapForETH is a temporary value computed inside swapBack.
success is a temporary flag produced by the low-level calls in swapBack.
